title: Explainable attention-based deep learning for classification and interpretation of heart murmurs using phonocardiograms
summary: Methods compare EHST with baselines across seven heart-sound datasets and evaluate segmentation and interpretability; Results report multi-class murmur performance and cross-validation. Retrospective classification supports the narrow task, not clinical utility.
ai_technology: Attention-based phonocardiogram learning classifies heart murmurs with an interpretable clinical signal analysis. The Methods specify the learned operation used for this case-specific result.
organization: School of Computer Science and Engineering (SCOPE), VIT-AP University, Amaravati, Vijayawada, India
